cohort: Frozen joint168 C8, 16 rank-local databases, no new measurements
contracts: Each measured layer retains its 5120→512 WKV projection (2,621,440 MAC per context row), RMS weight and BF16 rounding, 448 unrotated + 64 rotated channels and layer-owned scatter. RMS task returns BF16 normalized values and FP32 reciprocal standard deviation. Retain that output or establish its liveness before omitting it.

Same registry key, process group, positions and generation permit one validated cos/sin pair; retain distinct configurations and error behavior for observable invalid indices. Same slot map generation, group, block size and invalid-page behavior permit shared page/offset. Distinct layer caches and later query overwrites must keep slot order, duplicates/sentinel semantics, padding and graph addresses. Empty/absent, packed/direct and multi-group forms need their original writer and units.

Shared scenario removes the five redundant lookup pairs, two redundant slot plans and the three per-layer reassemblies, retaining the first applicable lookup pair and first slot plan. Direct writer scenarios also remove intermediate slices/copies and redundant coefficient casts while retaining all times of all three original WKV, RMS, rotary, scatters and one original lookup pair, one cast pair and one slot plan. 50% or 100% is the assumed realized share of that avoidable native time; 100% gives those lines zero replacement cost. Preserve source semantics wherever an intermediate has another reader.

Independent-rank free span gives every wave the entire slowest live panel span, through all three layers and all between-task gaps, even removing necessary arithmetic; frozen number of iterations, other work and original inclusive deadlines. All named cases instead price the change at the latest next-target entry with archived clock offsets. Earliest publication, CPU work outside the interval or other scheduling changes are not measured. Eager/mixed and graph scenarios price the same eight requests independently.

Projection grouping can additionally save at most two 5120-wide BF16 source reads per row, 20,480 logical bytes. Its traffic-only estimate uses the archived effective same-byte copy rate, ignores caches and does not credit changing GEMM arithmetic/tiling. This is an overlapping alternative, not extra full projection time.

Two host-only sensitivity cases assume all saved caller work reaches the same next-iteration frontier. One prices only measured CANN launch calls for removable intermediate tasks. The other erases the complete first-to-last CANN launch wall span, including all inter-launch gaps and required launches. Device work can overlap this whole interval. They are neither realized savings nor additive to GPU savings; native launch API timing does not identify the Python caller or time spent waiting for a later synchronisation.

For joint scenarios all target selection ends precede context panels, which end before the first draft score projection on each live rank. Combine local times before the rank maximum and retain original score calibration assumptions. The joint free-named case removes even the original target gather, ArgMax and draft adds, and all budgeted context intermediates, with zero replacement cost. The independent-rank named bound assigns each wave its largest combined live-rank saving using its upper communication bound. A further component relaxation lets the three regions choose different maximizing live ranks in every wave. It does not free W2, WKV, RMS, rotation, scatter, inter-task gaps or external host/communication scheduling.

Ordinary requests use their actual prompt lengths and verification counts, paired with frozen C8 per-rank median native task times. Interpolate first proposal between enclosing C8 context shapes; T6 one-request verification uses four TP-group calls. Price one prompt and every verification, under favorable propagation. Actual cache reuse, concurrence and the final request publication edge can lower the benefit. No ordinary operator timing or equivalence test is claimed.
